profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Mobile & Web Architect | Drupal, Ionic, Angular, React, AWS | Healthcare & Education Technology | Contractor at Radiant Digital | Open to Select Projects
profile.summary:
Software Developer & Technical Project Lead with 20+ years of experience designing and delivering educational and healthcare solutions for web, mobile, and desktop platforms. I bring a systems-thinking approach grounded in engineering principles, with a proven ability to simplify complex problems, streamline processes, and deliver high-quality products on time and under budget.

As a Certified ScrumMaster, I’ve led Agile teams through full development cycles, from requirements gathering to deployment and support. My work bridges technical execution with client engagement, ensuring solutions meet both functional needs and user expectations.

Core Strengths & Skills:
• Full-Stack Development: JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3, Node.js, Ionic, Strapi, React
• Mobile & Web Delivery: iOS & Android builds, responsive design, PWAs
• Databases & APIs: MySQL, REST
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Elastic Beanstalk
• Legacy & Integration Expertise: SCORM/LMS, Drupal services, Flash/ActionScript, ASP
• Project Leadership: Agile/Scrum facilitation, cross-functional team leadership, client communications

Notable Projects:
• Led development of a cross-platform mobile intervention app promoting HPV vaccination, integrated with analytics for research use.
• Built a gamified parent–child educational program with cross-platform delivery and research data integration.
• Developed a clinical decision support tool for epilepsy patients, integrating with a Drupal-based backend.
• Converted instructor-led multimedia courses into fully online, self-paced e-learning modules.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer / Grants Program Manager (Part-time Contract)
positions.description: Continuing to support Radiant Digital on a part-time contract basis, providing continuity for existing healthcare and education technology projects originally developed during my tenure as a full-time employee. Responsibilities include maintenance, incremental feature development, technical guidance, and ongoing support for deployed applications and client initiatives. Focused on sustaining and supporting active grant-funded projects, production systems, and client deliverables.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer / Grants Program Manager
positions.description:
I lead the design and development of educational and healthcare-focused applications for web, mobile, and desktop delivery, often within grant-funded and non-profit projects. My work spans technical development, Agile team leadership, and client engagement.

Key Highlights:
• Serve as ScrumMaster on multiple projects, facilitating sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
• Architect and develop cross-platform mobile applications (iOS, Android) using Ionic, Capacitor, Angular/React, and Strapi/MySQL backends.
• Built and deployed a mobile app promoting HPV vaccination, integrating analytics to track engagement for research studies.
• Created a gamified educational program combining multimedia learning with collectible game mechanics, with backend data integration via Drupal services.
• Developed clinical decision support systems and multimedia survey interventions deployed in medical offices.
• Manage client relationships, project budgets, statements of work, and cross-functional coordination.
• Deploy and maintain applications using AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Docker, and related cloud services.

positions.title: Software Developer / IT Manager
positions.description:
• Engineered immersive e-learning simulations using Flash/ActionScript, HTML/JS, and ASP.
• Delivered 120+ multimedia lessons through a reusable player architecture.
• Created integration frameworks for multiple SCORM-compliant LMS platforms.
• Provided QA, documentation, and client integration support.
• Managed IT infrastructure, hardware, and software procurement.
positions.insights: Skills: SCORM · Adobe Flash · Project Management · Databases · E-Learning · HTML · Software Development · Client Relations · SQL · ActionScript · Learning Management Systems · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Project Manager
positions.description:
• Led large-scale content integration following acquisition, delivering 200+ multimedia course titles in a single year (128 new, 89 retrofit).
• Ensured Section 508 accessibility compliance across all deliverables.
• Improved production workflows to support increased scale and tighter delivery timelines.

positions.title: Multimedia Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed courseware templates reducing engineering time.
• Served as primary technical contact for LMS integrations.

positions.title: Multimedia Engineer
positions.description:
Early team member at a Wichita-based eLearning startup later acquired by NETg; continued through acquisition into scaled production environment.
• Helped develop the company’s first in-house online Learning Management System (LMS) in a startup environment.
• Built and delivered interactive courseware while helping establish scalable production workflows.
• Streamlined development processes, reducing time-to-market for new course releases.
• Contributed across engineering, infrastructure, and desktop support in a small, fast-moving team.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Flash · Databases · E-Learning · HTML · Software Development · ActionScript · Learning Management Systems

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Administered and maintained a local area network serving over 120 clients in a combined Microsoft Windows and Apple Macintosh environment. 
• Maintained ongoing backups of data on the network. 
• Provided ongoing technical support to users for email, word processing, desktop publishing, spreadsheet and database manipulation, scheduling and the internet.

positions.title: Computing Coordinator; Research, Graduate Studies, and Public Service
positions.description:
• Administered and maintained a 30-node NetWare network with MS-DOS/Windows and Macintosh clients. 
• Supported common PC and Macintosh applications. 
• Developed and maintained new and existing database applications to track externally sponsored projects.
